exposure_anchors.1: Negligible: not a regulated trading venue / broker / asset manager / issuer; no staff with MNPI access.
exposure_anchors.2: Limited: occasional access to inside information (small adviser, single-issuer dealings).
exposure_anchors.3: Moderate: regulated entity with limited trading book or single-product venue.
exposure_anchors.4: High: trading desk + asset management; CASP listing tradable tokens; published research function.
exposure_anchors.5: Severe: multi-asset venue, sell-side trading, large issuer with frequent material announcements.

threat_credibility_anchors.1: No documented MAR enforcement in this profile.
threat_credibility_anchors.4: Active and adapted: insider patterns documented in adjacent firms.
threat_credibility_anchors.5: Active and targeted: prior enforcement contact or prominent named-and-shamed peer.

vulnerability_anchors.1: Surveillance + insider list + PA-dealing + disclosure + training + STOR pathway in place + audited.
vulnerability_anchors.2: Programme broadly in place with minor gaps.
vulnerability_anchors.3: Programme partial: surveillance present, insider list inconsistent, training thin.
vulnerability_anchors.4: Programme weak: surveillance limited; STOR pathway theoretical.
vulnerability_anchors.5: No surveillance, no insider list, no PA-dealing policy, no STOR pathway.
